en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a wide street lined with early 20th-century buildings, with shops, pedestrians, a vintage car, and a horse-drawn carriage. The lower left corner in Cyrillic and Latin reads 'VARNA - STR 6 SEPTEMBER', identifying the street and city. The reverse side has handwritten Cyrillic script, a red postage stamp from Bulgaria, postal marks, and an official purple stamp with 'VARNA' visible.
